tools.name: get_payment_quote
tools.description: Returns current price, accepted payment networks (Solana, Base, Base-Sepolia), and available rails (x402 EVM, Solana MPP) for inference and agent services.

tools.name: verify_payment_receipt
tools.description: Verify a payment receipt via Solana MPP proxy or local HMAC-SHA256. Accepts Payment-Receipt, X-Clawd-Pay-Receipt, or Authorization: Payment headers.

receipt.description: The payment receipt string to verify.

tools.name: forward_chat_completion
tools.description: Forward a paid chat/completions request to ClawdRouter, x402 OpenRouter, or direct OpenRouter. Requires a valid payment receipt or X-Payment header. Routes by upstream priority: ClawdRouter > x402 OpenRouter > direct OpenRouter.

model.description: Model identifier. Use 'auto' to let ClawdRouter choose.

payment_receipt.description: Payment receipt for Solana MPP or HMAC verification.

tools.name: get_commerce_agent
tools.description: Returns Metaplex Agent Registry identity, executive delegation status, Genesis bonding curve token-launch hints, and payment routes for compute, inference, MCP, and agent services.

agentAsset.description: Metaplex MPL Core asset address for the agent.

tools.name: execute_spot_trade
tools.description: Route a Solana spot trade across Jupiter, Raydium, Orca, Phoenix, or OpenBook with TWAP/VWAP execution, smart order splitting, and priority fee optimization.

amountIn.description: Amount in smallest units (lamports for SOL, base units for SPL).

tools.name: run_perps_preflight
tools.description: Run Vulcan preflight checks for Phoenix perpetuals: market snapshot, margin status, position list, lot sizing validation, and risk limit audit before any live execution.

market.description: Phoenix perps market address or symbol (e.g. SOL-PERP).

tools.name: fetch_birdeye_perps_snapshot
tools.description: Fetch live Birdeye Perps Data API HTTP snapshots for Global Fees Paid, Perps Token List, Token Overview, Token Open Positions, Token Liquidation Map, Perps Wallet, or x402 pay-per-request access.

resource.description: Birdeye HTTP resource to request. Token overview maps to GET https://public-api.birdeye.so/perps/v1/token/overview.

token.description: Uppercase token symbol for token resources, for example SOL, BTC, or ETH. Required for perps_token_overview, perps_token_open_positions, and perps_token_liquidation_map.

wallet.description: Wallet address for wallet-scoped perps data. Required for perps_wallet.

exchange.description: Perpetuals exchange passed in the x-perp header.

sortBy.description: Optional sort field for Perps Token Open Positions.

sortType.description: Optional sort order for Perps Token Open Positions.

tools.name: subscribe_birdeye_websocket_stream
tools.description: Subscribe to a live Birdeye WebSocket stream: Token/Pair OHLCV, Token/Pair Transactions, Base-Quote OHLCV, New Token Listing, New Pair, Track Large Transactions, Wallet Transactions, Token Stats, Meme Stats, or Transfer.

stream.description: Birdeye WebSocket stream to subscribe to.

token.description: Optional token symbol or mint, depending on the selected stream.

pair.description: Optional pair address or token pair identifier, depending on the selected stream.

minUsd.description: Minimum USD threshold for track_large_transactions streams.

tools.name: track_whale_wallets
tools.description: Monitor large on-chain Solana wallets for accumulation, distribution, and coordinated move patterns using Helius and Birdeye data.

wallets.description: List of wallet addresses to track. Omit to use top-100 whale list.

minTransferUsd.description: Minimum USD value to flag a transfer.

tools.name: analyze_tokenomics
tools.description: Model token supply schedules, vesting cliffs, inflation curves, and holder concentration for a Solana token. Returns a risk-scored tokenomics report.

whitepaper_url.description: Optional link to the project whitepaper.

tools.name: spawn_agent
tools.description: Spawn a specialist sub-agent from the Solana Clawd fleet to handle a discrete task. Returns a task ID for polling results.

agentId.description: Library identifier of the agent to spawn (e.g. solana-whale-tracker, solana-perpetuals-trader).

task.description: Task description or structured prompt for the agent.

context.description: Optional key-value context passed to the spawned agent.

tools.name: get_onchain_metrics
tools.description: Fetch Solana on-chain metrics: DEX volume, TVL, active wallets, protocol flows, and token-level analytics via Helius, Birdeye, and custom RPC endpoints.

protocol.description: Filter by protocol name (e.g. raydium, orca, meteora). Omit for all.
